correctness.rationale: Continuity and the delta jump condition give the exact monotone scalar equation k_d tanh(k_d d)+q_d tanh(q_d d)=alpha. Subcritically, expanding at the unique full-line root a and using b>a shows k_d-a=(2ab/alpha)e^(-2ad)(1+o(1)), which converts to the stated energy coefficient. At criticality, the root equation first forces k_d d to zero and y_d d=O(e^(-2alpha d)); expanding both tanh terms in y=k_d^2 yields y(d+1/(2alpha))=2alpha e^(-2alpha d)(1+o(1)). Independent numerical roots reproduced the subcritical rescaled constants within about 0.6 percent or better and the critical constants to better than 1e-6 in the tested cases.
